01 writeup
01 / CASE SUMMARY
SECURITY RESEARCH

How I Found 2 Critical Vulnerabilities in One of Nigeria’s Largest Institutions

Two IDOR flaws in a student portal exposed personal profiles and academic transcripts to other authenticated students. Responsibly disclosed and published after remediation.

Severity
Critical (author-rated)
Bug class
IDOR / Broken access control
Remediation
Remediated
FINDING 01

Student profile exposure

A logged-in student could change a user identifier and retrieve another student's personal profile because the API did not check access to the requested record.

Impact

Exposed names, dates of birth, contact information, next-of-kin details, and academic profile data.

FINDING 02

Transcript download authorization bypass

The results view rejected access to another student's records, but the separate PDF download route lacked the equivalent authorization check.

Impact

An authenticated student could download another student's full academic transcript.

Disclosure & remediation

  1. Discovered during a private security assessment
  2. Responsibly disclosed to the institution
  3. Published after remediation

The published timeline states that the institution was notified and the details were released after remediation. Fix details, dates, and a CVSS score are not provided in the article.
